declaration.goal: Crawl ahead by 0.3 to 0.5 m, keeping within 0.2 m of the start line and within 20 degrees of the start heading.
declaration.measured_by: Computed from the simulator's pose, as the quantities a camera straight above could measure; not measured from a camera image. The camera sees a floor area of 2.59 m by 1.46 m. x, y and heading are relative to the start of each trial: x in the direction the body faces at the start, y to its left, heading counter-clockwise seen from above, in (-180, 180]. At the start the body is at x = 0, y = 0, and the view spans x from -0.84 to 1.74 m and y from -0.73 to 0.73 m. A value is lost when the camera could not see the tracked point.

statement.text: WHEN c1 is held at a1 = -0.5 and c3 is a unit sine at f = 2 Hz with the other inputs 0, THE system SHALL reach x between 0.3 and 0.5 m with |heading| under 20 deg and |y| under 0.2 m.

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: P1 and P2 missed. T1 (a1=-0.5, s3=1, f=2): x -0.055, y 0.012, heading -7.7. T2 (a1=-0.75, s3=1, f=2): x -0.050, heading -6.4. T3 (a1=-1, s3=0.6, f=2): x -0.035, heading -0.7. The body barely moved and went slightly backward, so R11 (about 0.06 m per cycle) did not hold at f=2 for a1 in [-1, -0.5] or for a reduced s3. The picture strips show the body nearly in place. Either the c1 gain depends on s3 or on a1 more sharply than R11 says, or the given beliefs do not carry over to this body. Next: rerun the E10 best point (a1=-1, s3=1, f=2, believed x about 0.62, heading 0) to check whether the given beliefs hold at all.

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: P1 and P2 missed. T4 (a1=-1, s3=1, f=2): x -0.050, heading -6.4. T5 (a1=-1, s3=1, f=1.5): x -0.023, heading -1.2. The a1=-1 and a1=-0.75 trials at f=2 gave almost the same track (x -0.0497 for both), so c1 has no effect here and the given E9/E10 beliefs (R11, R13, R9) do not carry over to this bench. The tracks show only small oscillation with a slight backward drift. I will probe the channels from scratch.
